It is projected that between 1996 and the end of 2000, over twenty statewide elections will have taken place to legalize the medical use of marijuana. It is necessary to go through the political process to legalize marijuana as medicine because the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has ruled that marijuana does not have medical utility.
(Ed. note: The FDA has made no such ruling. This is a lie, plain and simple.)

In fact, even in the 1970’s when no effective medicines to treat chemotherapy induced nausea had been developed, marijuana was considered by many in the medical community as the best available medicine.
(Ed. note: This is really bizarre. Although they don’t seem to realize it, they are admitting that marijuana prohibition caused great suffering and death for cancer patients in the 1970s! NORML filed suit to get marijuana rescheduled in 1972. The DEA fought this, denying that marijuana had any medical value. Now they are admitting that it was the best available medicine. There are now new pharmaceutical anti-emetics, but they are very expensive and do not work for everyone.)
